propositions: The eight-phrase _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS tuple is duplicated byte-identical in failure.py and sizing.py, creating a maintenance hazard where fixes to one silently leave the other stale.
sizing.is_context_limit_error must remain a def in plan_review/sizing.py because it is imported at module level by orchestrator and monkeypatched by name in tests.
The tuple can be imported from failure.py into sizing.py without creating a circular dependency because failure.py imports only rebar.llm.errors.

workflow/completion_failures.py contains a deliberately different context-length classifier that omits the bare 'context' substring and keys off finish_reason, and must not be collapsed with the other two.
Proposed consolidations of retryable→exit-code mapping and structured.py message handling are withdrawn as already centralized or deliberately divergent per prior design decisions.
